title: nan
authors: Xu C.; Chen S.; Zhao D.; Hou Z.; Jiang C.
key_contribution: Proposes a SINS/GNSS hybrid information fusion method using attention-augmented TCN to provide positioning during GNSS-denied periods, verified with real drone flight data.
